front_blocks.md: How did the Nazi-Soviet Pact contribute to the outbreak of war?

back_blocks.md: The pact gave Hitler the perfect conditions to invade Poland, knowing he would **only fight a war with Britain and France**.

front_blocks.md: **True or False?**
Britain and France were still following appeasement when Germany invaded Poland.

back_blocks.md: **False.**
Britain and France abandoned appeasement by March 1939, as they did not believe Hitler would stop his aggressive foreign policy.
